initial_receipt.explanation: The execution is faulty because the stipulated corpus contains eight qualifying demand records: all records n06-r01 through n06-r08 have demand_score >= 3 and should be retained. Job 1 output silently omits n06-r01, so Job 2 only receives seven needs and correctly preserves those handoffs downstream. The supplied function evidence localizes the omission to normalize, whose allowed_record_ids replaces n06-r01 with n06-r09 and then filters retained rows by that list.
